name: GovAssure is mandatory if identified as in-scope to ensure compliance with a statutory obligation.
requirementTitle: GovAssure is mandatory if identified as in-scope to ensure compliance with a statutory obligation.
requirementDescription: If your system or service has been identified as being within the scope of GovAssure, then participating in the GovAssure process is not optional. It is a mandatory requirement because it supports a legal or government policy obligation.
why: GovAssure is the UK Government's cyber security assurance scheme. It assesses critical government systems against the NCSC Cyber Assessment Framework (CAF) to measure cyber security and resilience.
